entries.source: I am never alone. I have the Way.
entries.target: 我并不孤单，我拥有维网。

entries.source: Activate the rune to increase your global speed by %d%% for %d turns.
entries.target: 激活这个符文提高全局速度 %d%% 持续 %d 回合。

entries.source:
Absorbs the life force of your foes as you kill them.
		As long as this talent is active, vim will decrease by 0.5 per turn and increase by %0.1f for each kill of a non-undead creature (in addition to the usual increase based on Willpower).
entries.target:
当你杀死敌人时，你会吸收目标生命。
		当此技能激活时，每回合会消耗 0.5 点活力；当你杀死一个非不死族单位时，会获得 %0.1f 点活力（此外自然增长受意志影响）。

entries.source: Spell and mind speed increased by 30%
#Target# is being driven mad by the void.
The way to the treasure is to the east. But beware, death probably awaits there.
entries.target: 通向宝藏的路在东边。但是请当心，死亡常常相伴。

entries.source: Nature requires balance in these matters.
entries.target: 自然在这些事上需要平衡。

entries.source: Maj'Eyal will once more know peace. Most of its inhabitants will never know they even were on the verge of destruction, but then this is what being a true hero means: to do the right thing even though nobody will know about it.
entries.target: 马基·埃亚尔将重归和平。大多数居民永远不会知道自己曾濒临毁灭，但这正是真正英雄的意义：即使无人知晓，也要做正确的事。

entries.source:
Transcend the physical and rule over all with an iron will!
		While this sustain is active, 33%% of your damage is converted into mind damage.
		Additionally, you gain +30%% mind resistance penetration, and +10%% mind damage.
entries.target:
超越肉体，以钢铁般的意志统治一切！
		维持此技能时，你造成伤害的 33%% 会转化为精神伤害。
		此外，你获得 30%% 精神抗性穿透和 10%% 精神伤害加成。

entries.source:
Welcome #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#.
You are of the Shaloren, the Elven race with the closest ties to magic, and you are despised.
While your people are at peace with the other kingdoms, many have not forgotten it was your race that created the terrible Spellblaze, thousands of years ago.

You have decided to venture into the old and wild places looking for ancient treasures and glory.

You have come to the north of the Shaloren capital city of Elvala, in search of the Scintillating Caves. It is infested with vermin and seemingly alive crystals.
To the west lies another dangerous place: a camp of Rhaloren. They are renegade Shaloren who do not wish to restrict their magic usage. Stopping them is good for both your race and your treasure hunt.

After days of travel, you have found the caves and entered it. What will you find there...?
entries.target:
欢迎你 #LIGHT_GREEN#@name@#WHITE#！
你是一个永恒精灵，精灵种族中与魔法联系最紧密的一个亚种，你被人鄙视。
虽然你的人民与其他王国和平相处，但许多人仍未忘记，正是你们的族人在数千年前引发了可怕的魔法大爆炸。

你决定前往那些古老而荒野的地方，寻找古老的宝藏和荣耀。

你来到了永恒精灵首都埃尔瓦拉北部，寻找闪光洞穴，那里被害虫和看似有生命的水晶所侵扰。
西部还有一个危险的地方：罗兰精灵营地。他们是永恒精灵的叛徒，不愿意限制他们对魔法的使用，阻止他们对你的族群和你搜寻宝物都有好处。

经过几天的旅行，你发现并进入了那些洞穴，你会发现什么呢？

entries.source: You focus your aim and fire a shot with great accuracy, inflicting %d%% weapon damage.  Afterwords your attack will remain improved for one turn as the chronomantic effects linger.
entries.target: 你集中注意力射出极精准的一箭，造成 %d%% 武器伤害。接下来的一回合内，因时空延续，攻击加成保留。

entries.source: Best results occur with tongues never tainted by profanity, so if you happen to know any saintly nagas...
entries.target: 最好的结果便是从未被污言秽语亵渎过的舌头，所以如果你正好碰到那些圣者娜迦……

entries.source: The target is gaining %d positive energy each turn.
entries.target: 目标每回合获得 %d 正能量。

entries.source: You do not have any items to transmogrify in your chest or on the floor.
entries.target: 你的宝箱内和地板上没有任何需要转化的物品。

entries.source: Have you any idea where they might be found?
entries.target: 你知道去哪里寻找这两样东西么？

entries.source: Black, interwoven tendrils form this mesh that can be used as a shield. It reacts visibly to your touch, clinging to your arm and engulfing it in a warm, black mass.
entries.target: 盾牌由许多黑色的触须交织而成。当你触摸它时，你可以感受它非常明显的反应，它缠绕住你的手臂并将其包裹在一团黑色而温暖的物质中。
%s启动了%s%s，召唤出一个吸血鬼随从！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#Quest '%s' is done! #WHITE#(Press 'j' to see the quest log)
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#任务“%s”完成！#WHITE#（按 J 键查看任务日志）

entries.source: You cannot use Thread Walk without an appropriate weapon!
entries.target: 你需要装备合适的武器来使用该技能
#CRIMSON#纳格尔杂种！我们遭到袭击了！

entries.source: A brawny Dwarven lumberjack, looking a bit upset at his current situation.
entries.target: 一个强壮的矮人伐木工，他对自己现在的处境有点不安。

entries.source: You are transformed by the heart of the Queen!
entries.target: 你被沙虫女皇之心所转化！

entries.source: %s is unable to use this kind of inscription.
Loremaster Greynot's Analysis of the Races - Chapter 3 - Dwarves
entries.target: 博学者格雷诺特关于人种的调查——第三章——矮人

entries.source: Statue of Queen Mirvenia the Inspirer
entries.target: 智慧王后米雯尼雅的雕像

entries.source: Well, I suppose it is better than dying.
#Target# stops taking damage received in the past.
shoot a cone of flames (radius %d) for %0.2f fire damage (based on Magic)
entries.target: 发射长度 %d 的锥形火焰，造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害（基于魔法）。

entries.source: #STEEL_BLUE#A time vortex briefly appears in front of you.
entries.target: #STEEL_BLUE#一个时间漩涡在你面前出现。
找到一个遥远的支持者

entries.source:
As you enter the dream portal you suddenly wake up.
You feel good!
entries.target:
当你进入了梦境传送门之时，你突然醒来。
你感觉神清气爽！

entries.source: Hits the target with a mighty blow to the legs doing %d%% weapon damage. If the attack hits, the target is unable to move for %d turns.
entries.target: 对目标的腿部进行重击，造成 %d%% 武器伤害，如果攻击命中，则目标无法移动，持续 %d 回合。

entries.source:
Imbues your body with arcane forces, reconstructing it to a default state, healing for %d life.
		The life healed will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
使你的身体充满奥术能量，将其重组为原始状态，治疗 %d 点生命值。
		治疗量受法术强度加成。
